reason: Two big customers cut orders, so I have a hole to fill and no time to wait for the next trade fair. Nothing up front and three free meetings means the most I lose is a few hours, so I would take the free 15-company list and, if it is not rubbish, start the pilot.
objection: I have paid for slides and 'leads' before. My worry is that the meetings will be polite calls with people who will never order, and I will spend my 48 hours arguing about what counts as a real buyer while my team is already stretched.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15 free companies are ones I already know or obviously wrong for our product, I stop there and do not sign the pilot.
